output.summary: KEP-3476 proposes new CRDs (VolumeGroupSnapshot, VolumeGroupSnapshotContent, VolumeGroupSnapshotClass) so users can take a crash-consistent snapshot of multiple volumes together, grouped by a label selector, for CSI volume drivers. Its current status is implementable, stage stable.
output.rationale: Individually snapshotting volumes one after another, with or without quiescing the application, can yield inconsistent point-in-time state across volumes and takes longer. The design adds a group snapshot API so multiple volumes are captured at the same point in time for write-order consistency. The sources record that the design was refined over several review rounds, including how snapshot lists are reported when a storage system does not return per-volume snapshots, but they do not explain the final stable-stage decision itself.

alternatives.option: Quiesce the application and take individual snapshots of each volume one after another
alternatives.why_not: The readme says application quiesce is time consuming, sometimes not possible, and taking individual snapshots one after another may take longer than a consistent group snapshot.

alternatives.option: Create a VolumeGroup from an arbitrary set of existing PVCs in the initial scope
alternatives.why_not: Maintainers moved this to Phase 2 to keep scope smaller; xing-yang wrote "Create VolumeGroup from existing PVCs with a selector is moved to Phase 2 as I want to make the scope of this KEP smaller initially."

alternatives.option: Add a ConsistentGroupSnapshot flag or a group-type hint to VolumeGroup
alternatives.why_not: This was raised as a way to tell drivers which group type is wanted (group snapshot vs replication), but the sources do not record a final decision on it.

evidence.quote: This proposal introduces a Kubernetes API that allows users to take a crash consistent snapshot of multiple volumes together.
application quiesce is time consuming. Sometimes it may not be possible to quiesce an application.
This proposal introduces new CRDs VolumeGroupSnapshot, VolumeGroupSnapshotContent, and VolumeGroupSnapshotClass.
Create VolumeGroup from existing PVCs with a selector is moved to Phase 2 as I want to make the scope of this KEP smaller initially.
If ReadyToUse is true and SnapshotList is empty, the volume group snapshot controller assumes the storage system does not return individual snapshots.
